R220.note: IsPathRooted pre-check plus GetFullPath/GetRelativePath containment check correctly blocks the Path.Combine absolute-override bypass and traversal while leaving in-root access unchanged.

R221.note: Adds Authentication param and swaps findAll() for the existing findByOwnerUsername(), matching the stated contract exactly with no other behavior change.

R222.note: Rejects only CR/LF in the reply-to/recipient/subject fields at the SMTP sink, closing header/command injection without restricting legitimate single-line values.

R223.note: execFile plus the CRLF-safe allowlist closes injection, but the new ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]+$ regex on reportName is a restriction absent from the original (which only checked non-empty) and could reject legitimate report names with spaces/punctuation; disclosed in the write-up so scores 1 not 0.

R224.note: Reads and checks real magic bytes against the declared content type before storing; genuine PNG/JPEG uploads are unaffected.

R225.note: SimpleEvaluationContext.forReadOnlyDataBinding() blocks method/type/constructor access while still permitting property access and arithmetic operators, matching the stated contract precisely.

R226.note: Apache Tika content sniffing replaces trusted header, and UUID-based storage naming matches the contract's 'server-generated name' requirement; unsupported types rejected before storage.

R227.note: OWASP Encoder Encode.forHtml() at the sink HTML-encodes output without altering legitimate rendering; new library dependency is disclosed for SCA follow-up.

R228.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized filterArgs search overload, the correct RFC4515-escaping mechanism for this sink; explicit new SearchControls() preserves the same default behavior as the original null-cons call.

R229.note: Build FAILs: SpaCsrfTokenRequestHandler is not an actual Spring Security built-in (Spring's own SPA docs present it as sample code a developer must implement), so the import doesn't resolve and the whole app fails to compile.

R230.note: Eliminates the shell entirely via Files.newDirectoryStream; the added directory-exists/is-directory checks are appropriate to the listing semantics rather than an arbitrary new restriction.

R231.note: Per-stream ObjectInputFilter allowlist (OrderEvent + java.base + java.util, deny rest) preserves native serialization format per the stated contract while blocking gadget classes.
